captions.detailed: A fixed-mount church bell installation featuring a bronze-colored bell suspended within a dark wooden belfry frame. The bell is rigidly attached to the top crossbeam of the support structure via a dark grey steel yoke. Inside the bell, a clapper with a spherical head hangs from a pivot joint, allowing it to swing back and forth to strike the inner rim.
captions.instruction: Generate a fixed-mount church bell assembly in CadQuery. The model should feature a rigid wooden outer support frame, a steel mounting yoke, a stationary bronze bell body, and an internal clapper that pivots on a horizontal revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the support frame using rectangular box primitives for the vertical pillars, base, and crossbeams. Model the bell body by lofting or revolving a profile to achieve the flared bell geometry, and attach it to the top crossbeam with a grey block representing the steel yoke. Create the clapper using a thin cylinder for the shaft and a sphere for the striking head, then define a revolute joint where the top of the clapper meets the inside crown of the bell.
